What plays on first open today

Nothing. The JF Coach intro film only ran inside the Spring welcome, which ended 11 Nov. New clients now get a plain welcome, the setup form, then a 5-tap coach-mark tour that points at the tab bar but never has them do anything.

Films get skipped: 329 people tapped Skip on the JF Go film. So the first open here is JFI, live, on the real screens, not a video.

Why it’s built this way
  • Learn by doing (Apple’s rule). Apple’s guidelines: onboarding is fast, fun and optional, teaches through interaction, and a skipped tutorial is never forced again but stays findable. Every step here only moves on when they tap the real button.
  • Booking is the self-coaching. Picking a day for a workout is an “implementation intention”, one of the best-proven habit tools (Gollwitzer and Sheeran, 94 studies). The training quest isn’t done until they actually do it.
  • Already 1 of 7 done. The tour ticks the first box, so the list starts with progress. Head-starts like this nearly doubled completion in the classic loyalty-card study (34% vs 19%).
  • An open loop and a prize at the end. An unfinished list nags (in a good way), effort speeds up near the finish, and the chest is the big pay-off. It reuses the Loot Chest already in the app.
  • Lazy-proof. One instruction per screen, 20 seconds to 2 minutes per quest, the camera opens straight away, and the message to their trainer is pre-written. “Not now” never loses progress.
  • Always findable. The chest button floats above the +, More shows “Tutorials and quests”, and Settings has a Tutorials page to replay any of them or hide the button.
Shipping notes

The phone shows real JF Coach screens from the live app (demo client, made-up data, nothing saved). The meal photo result is a demo answer; in the app JFI reads the actual photo.

In the app: the quests reuse the existing tour engine and Loot Chest, points go into JF points, the chest rolls from the real Legendary pool, and JFI and Ava learn the quests so “how do I…” and “where’s my chest” get the right answer.
